label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Rocket Classic Tight Race
items.text: Cameron Young, Patrick Cantlay, and Patrick Fishburn are tied for the lead at 10-under after two rounds at the Rocket Classic, with Saturday's moving day set for a tightly packed chase.

items.headline: Brad Dalke Struggles
items.text: YouTube golfer Brad Dalke struggled with rounds of 83 and 5-over, finishing 16-over and last among finishers at the Rocket Classic; he acknowledged his poor play must improve.
